description: Apply a list of raw Google Docs API batchUpdate request objects (insert/replace text, formatting, etc.) to a document. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the replies arrive via a follow-up message once it completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Apply raw Google Docs API batchUpdate requests to an existing document by id as a background job - insertText, replaceAllText, updateTextStyle, insertTable and the rest - passed through verbatim. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the batchUpdate replies array. The low-level structural edit surface for documents.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the batch update; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to apply structural edit requests to a Google Docs document.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, requests is empty/not a list of dicts, a request object is malformed per the Docs API, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the document id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a non-empty list of valid Docs API request objects. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
